title: SharpaDex held-out evaluation (episodes 390-409, 130 windows of 49 frames, seed 0)

models.camlora: Wan2.1 1.3B camera + LoRA (v3_mix_cam_lora32 5k; never trained on SharpaDex)

metrics.psnr: PSNR (dB) vs the real video over frames >= 1, full frame
metrics.psnr_hand: same, inside the dilated conditioning hand silhouette

notes: Only PSNR was computed: no SSIM / LPIPS, and no hand-pose estimator applies to these robot hands.
The generated videos have not been reviewed by eye clip by clip (no hand check).
ci95: cluster bootstrap over the 20 held-out episodes, 10000 resamples.
steps come from the prompt (frame-aligned subtask captions covered by the window); all with the right hand.
One sample per clip (seed 0). 1.3B samples with 30 steps / CFG 5.0, A14B with 40 steps / CFG 3.5 (each model's default).
